# Inference

- Development is underway for the MRS Model Criticality Guidelines. The current draft is being refined with an expected completion date of tomorrow, after which it will be distributed for feedback.
  - Objective: Align MRS Serving SLOs with upstream "AIDI" IPNext criticality-based assurances.
  - Strategy: To meet these rigorous Serving Success Rate (SSR) targets, MRS is implementing per-model criteria. These requirements account for regional distribution, hardware availability, and cross-regional latency limitations, allowing model owners to maintain high SSR while meeting latency needs.
